description: This file implements a lightweight recursive lock using interlocked operations and thread-local storage, providing methods to acquire, try to acquire, and release the lock, as well as a string representation of its state.

classes.name: RecursiveInterlockedExchangeLock
classes.description: A lightweight recursive lock that allows the same thread to acquire the lock multiple times, using interlocked operations for thread safety.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock without blocking, returning true if successful.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Acquires the lock, blocking if necessary until it becomes available.

methods.name: TryRelease
methods.description: Releases the lock if held by the current thread, returning true if successful.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string indicating whether the lock is unlocked or locked by a specific thread.
